# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_config_reference.py from the pydantic schema; do not edit by hand. -->

A project is described by one YAML file that validates against the pydantic v2 model tree below
(`extra="forbid"`: unknown keys are errors, ADR-0009). `regimekit validate-config` checks a file and writes
the fully resolved configuration (every default filled in); `regimekit config-schema OUT.json` exports the
JSON-Schema for editor support. The reference configuration is `examples/configs/dax_3state_gbm_nb.yaml`.

Types use the schema's own names; `required` marks fields without a default. Global CLI options
(`--seed`, `--device`, `--log-level`, `--out`, `--offline`) override `project.seed`, `estimation.device`,
`project.log_level`, `project.output_dir` and the cache policy for one invocation.

## `(top level)`

The whole resolved regimekit configuration.

| Field | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | `int` | `1` |
| `profile` | `'core' \| 'finance'` | `'finance'` |
| `project` | `ProjectSection` | required |
| `data` | `DataSection` | required |
| `model` | `ModelSection` | required |
| `estimation` | `EstimationSection` | required |
| `forecast` | `ForecastSection` | required |
| `evaluation` | `EvaluationSection` | required |
| `output` | `OutputSection` | required |
| `warnings` | `list[str]` | `[]` |

## `project`

`project:` — run identity, seed, output location, logging.
